# SnapPro

> SnapPro (snappro.in) is an Indian online marketplace for booking verified professional photographers and videographers. A customer posts a shoot (type, photos / video / both, date, time, duration, city and budget); verified photographers in that city send their own quotes; the customer compares portfolios, ratings and prices and books online. Payment is through Razorpay: 25% advance to confirm, balance in the app once the shoot starts. There is no booking fee for customers.

Key facts:
- Works across India, including Mumbai, Delhi, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai, Kolkata, Pune, Ahmedabad, Jaipur, Gurugram, Noida, Chandigarh, Lucknow, Kochi, Goa, Udaipur and more.
- Shoot types: Wedding, Pre-wedding, Birthday, Corporate, Event, Maternity, Product, Food, Fashion, Real estate, Portrait, Pet, Candid.
- Guide prices for a 2-hour shoot (photographers quote their own price): Wedding ₹12,000; Pre-wedding ₹12,000; Birthday ₹3,500; Corporate ₹7,000; Event ₹4,000; Maternity ₹6,000; Product ₹5,000; Food ₹4,500; Fashion ₹8,000; Real estate ₹5,500; Portrait ₹2,500; Pet ₹2,800; Candid ₹2,200. Same-day bookings cost more.
- Photos, video or both: the customer chooses when posting; only photographers who offer that are alerted and can quote. Guide prices for video are about 1.3x the photo price, photos + video about 1.8x (e.g. a 2-hour wedding shoot: photos ₹12,000, video ₹15,600, both ₹21,600).
- Every photographer lists their gear (camera body and model, lenses, drone, gimbal, lights, microphone, or the phone model if they shoot on a phone). It is shown on their profile and next to every quote; customers can filter by Pro camera, Has drone or Shoots on phone.
- Each photographer chooses how far they travel: their own city, a distance in km, their whole state, or anywhere in India. A request reaches photographers whose range covers the customer's city.
- Photographers are approved by the SnapPro team after a portfolio review and verify their identity with photos of the front and back of a government ID and a face photo. Ratings come only from completed bookings.
- Short notice: customers can ask for a photographer right now, in 1 hour, in 3 hours, later today, tomorrow or on a date; short-notice shoots cost about 15–60% more.
- Cancellation: full advance refunded if the customer cancels before the photographer sets off; 50% of the advance after.
- Photographers join free, quote their own prices, and receive their share by UPI after the shoot.
- Contact: snappro.support@gmail.com

## Photographers by type
- [Wedding photographers](https://snappro.in/wedding-photographers/): ceremonies, rituals, family portraits and candid moments from haldi and mehendi to the pheras and reception
- [Pre-wedding photographers](https://snappro.in/pre-wedding-photographers/): couple shoots before the wedding — at a favourite spot in your city, at golden hour or with a theme
- [Birthday photographers](https://snappro.in/birthday-photographers/): kids' parties, milestone birthdays and surprise celebrations — candids, cake-cutting and family photos
- [Corporate photographers](https://snappro.in/corporate-photographers/): headshots, team photos, office shoots, conferences, product launches and company events
- [Event photographers](https://snappro.in/event-photographers/): parties, anniversaries, engagements, poojas, college fests, launches and get-togethers
- [Maternity photographers](https://snappro.in/maternity-photographers/): pregnancy portraits at home, in a studio or outdoors — solo, with your partner or with family
- [Product photographers](https://snappro.in/product-photographers/): e-commerce listings, catalogue photos, Amazon and Flipkart images, lifestyle and social media shots
- [Food photographers](https://snappro.in/food-photographers/): restaurant menus, Zomato and Swiggy listings, cafés, cloud kitchens and food brands
- [Fashion photographers](https://snappro.in/fashion-photographers/): model portfolios, lookbooks, clothing brands, designer collections and influencer shoots
- [Real estate photographers](https://snappro.in/real-estate-photographers/): flats, villas, offices, hotels, homestays and Airbnb listings — bright, wide interior and exterior photos
- [Portrait photographers](https://snappro.in/portrait-photographers/): personal portraits, profile photos, family portraits, couple portraits and portfolio shoots
- [Pet photographers](https://snappro.in/pet-photographers/): dogs, cats and other pets — at home, in a park or with the family
- [Candid photographers](https://snappro.in/candid-photographers/): natural, unposed photos — outings, trips, small celebrations and everyday moments
